verdict.rationale: n8n runs a public workflow template library at n8n.io/workflows, advertised as 12,116–12,326 community automation workflows, and the GitHub README cites 9,000+ templates. That clearly covers starting from a template instead of building from scratch. missing for 10: documentation of how a template is imported and customized in an instance, independent hands-on corroboration of template quality and usability for ops use cases.
